_readme: Pokemon creators from Rochester and the wider region. Drives /creators.html.
EMPTY UNTIL TIM FILLS IT IN. These are real people. A wrong handle sends
traffic to a stranger, and a made-up creator is worse than an empty page.
AREA is one of: Rochester, Buffalo, Syracuse, or Upstate NY for anywhere else
close enough to count. Same rule as the card show calendar: check the zip or
the profile before adding. A national search for 'Rochester Pokemon' returns
Rochester MINNESOTA and Rochester MICHIGAN above ours.
Add one with a name and an area. Optional: blurb, youtube, instagram, tiktok,
twitch, url, does (what they make: rips, singles, art, competitive).
Handles go in WITHOUT the @ and without a full url. The builder links them.
THIS IS NOT A RANKING. Order is alphabetical by name, deliberately, so the
page cannot read as a league table of local creators.

creators.name: Toak Pulls

creators.blurb: They do all of it: live streams, comedy, and pack openings. Worth a follow, and you can buy from them in person at the local shows too.
